content: EU VAT Directive (2006/112/EC) full invoice must contain: date of issue; unique sequential invoice number; supplier full name+address; customer full name+address; customer VAT ID (if customer liable); supplier VAT ID; description+quantity of goods/services; unit price exclusive of tax/discounts unless included; date of transaction/payment if different; VAT rate applied and amount; VAT breakdown by rate/exemption; credit notes must reference initial invoice. Extra info in some cases: exemption reference, 'reverse charge', 'self-billing', 'cash accounting', margin scheme, tax representative. EU allows electronic invoices; B2B invoices mandatory for most supplies. UK GOV.UK: invoices must include VAT number and show VAT separately. Simplified invoices allowed for some B2C.
